user_profiles_deactivation_consistent.name: user_profiles_deactivation_consistent
user_profiles_deactivation_consistent.value: ("user_profiles"."status" = 'deactivated') = ("user_profiles"."deactivated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "user_profiles"."deactivated_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

suppliers_tax_id_pair.name: suppliers_tax_id_pair
suppliers_tax_id_pair.value: ("suppliers"."tax_id" IS NULL) = ("suppliers"."tax_id_normalized" IS NULL) AND ("suppliers"."tax_id" IS NULL OR char_length("suppliers"."tax_id") <= 40)

suppliers_text_lengths.name: suppliers_text_lengths
suppliers_text_lengths.value:
coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."email"), 0) <= 254 AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."phone"), 0) <= 30
        AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."address_line1"), 0) <= 200 AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."address_line2"), 0) <= 200
        AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."city"), 0) <= 100 AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."region"), 0) <= 100
        AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."postal_code"), 0) <= 20 AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."review_note"), 0) <= 2000
        AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."status_reason"), 0) <= 2000

suppliers_maker_checker.name: suppliers_maker_checker
suppliers_maker_checker.value: "suppliers"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NULL OR ("suppliers"."reviewed_by_user_id" <> "suppliers"."created_by_user_id" AND "suppliers"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "suppliers"."identity_changed_by_user_id")

approval_steps_activated_consistent.name: approval_steps_activated_consistent
approval_steps_activated_consistent.value: CASE "approval_steps"."status" WHEN 'waiting' THEN "approval_steps"."activated_at" IS NULL WHEN 'cancelled' THEN true ELSE "approval_steps"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL END

approval_steps_decided_consistent.name: approval_steps_decided_consistent
approval_steps_decided_consistent.value: ("approval_steps"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'returned')) = ("approval_steps"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_steps"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

approval_steps_comment_length.name: approval_steps_comment_length
approval_steps_comment_length.value: "approval_steps"."comment" IS NULL OR char_length("approval_steps"."comment") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

approval_steps_comment_only_on_decision.name: approval_steps_comment_only_on_decision
approval_steps_comment_only_on_decision.value: "approval_steps"."comment" IS NULL OR "approval_steps"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL

approval_steps_comment_required.name: approval_steps_comment_required
approval_steps_comment_required.value: "approval_steps"."status" NOT IN ('rejected', 'returned') OR "approval_steps"."comment" IS NOT NULL

purchase_requisitions_cancel_consistent.name: purchase_requisitions_cancel_consistent
purchase_requisitions_cancel_consistent.value: ("purchase_requisitions"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("purchase_requisitions"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_requisitions"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

purchase_requisitions_approved_states.name: purchase_requisitions_approved_states
purchase_requisitions_approved_states.value: "purchase_requisitions"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'closed') OR "purchase_requisitions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL

purchase_requisitions_close_consistent.name: purchase_requisitions_close_consistent
purchase_requisitions_close_consistent.value: ("purchase_requisitions"."status" = 'closed') = ("purchase_requisitions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_requisitions"."closed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_requisitions"."close_reason" IS NOT NULL)
